en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard view of a lakeside promenade with balustrades and a vine‑covered pergola in front of two grand villas among leafless trees. Printed caption at the bottom reads "Bad Pyrmont. Villa Königin Louise." There is cursive handwriting across the sky on the picture. The reverse has German handwriting, a green 5‑Pfennig Germania stamp, a circular BAD PYRMONT postmark, and a large stamp mark of the local museum.
